coverage: Selected courts in five Ohio counties; use the official statewide court directory for other courts.

courts.name: Morrow Municipal Court
courts.instructions: Under Search Criminal and Traffic Case Records, choose Cases (status), then search for your case. The court currently posts a technical-difficulties notice.
courts.note: No usable expungement packet verified here. If the search is unavailable, the clerk is at 419-947-5045.

courts.name: Morrow Common Pleas
courts.instructions: Open the county clerk’s Case Inquiry portal for Common Pleas records. Follow its public-access prompts; JavaScript may be required.
links: County clerk: Case Inquiry, Forms and contact
courts.note: The county clerk confirms this portal, but its search screens were not fully inspected. For missing records, call the legal division at 419-947-2085.

courts.name: Mount Vernon Municipal Court
courts.instructions: Read the disclaimer, select I Accept, Continue, then use the court’s case-search menu. This portal requires JavaScript.
courts.note: The reviewed application cites 2953.32/2953.33; confirm the accepted packet for marijuana-specific 2953.321 relief.

courts.name: Knox Common Pleas
courts.instructions: Use the Common Pleas Public Records Search portal. Complete its image challenge and choose the public-records search. Search the criminal case, not juvenile or probate records.
links: Official court link and contact routes
courts.note: Search access is linked by the Municipal Court. A Common Pleas expungement packet has not been verified in this guide. Clerk: 740-393-6788.

courts.name: Delaware Municipal Court
courts.instructions: Choose Case Lookup on the Municipal Court homepage. Use this court’s search for its misdemeanor and traffic cases, rather than the separate Common Pleas portal.
courts.note: The official page lists Case Lookup and a sealing form; the search destination and full current packet were not inspected. Criminal / traffic clerk: 740-203-1570.

courts.name: Delaware Common Pleas
courts.instructions: Choose Case Search in the public portal, then search by name or case number. Filing is a separate option and requires a login.
links: Clerk forms, including required identifier forms
courts.note: The general conviction application also requires a confidential-personal-identifiers form. Confirm the full packet before filing.

courts.name: Franklin Municipal Court
courts.instructions: Enter your first and last name, or your case number. Not every field is required. If there are too many results, narrow by case year or criminal case type. Open the matching case and its docket.
courts.note: This search does not cover Franklin Common Pleas. A closed status alone does not establish sentence completion. Confirm the accepted packet for 2953.321.

courts.name: Franklin Common Pleas
courts.instructions: Read and accept the Case Information Online conditions. Use its name or case-number search for Common Pleas criminal records. This is separate from Municipal Court.
courts.note: The clerk lists these general forms. The nonconviction packet was read; the conviction and indigency PDF links were confirmed on the clerk’s page but their full contents were not inspected.

courts.name: Hamilton Municipal and Common Pleas
courts.instructions: Under Name, choose Search Criminal & Traffic; or choose Search By Case Number. Confirm the court shown on the result. Both court types are linked from this records page.
links: Common Pleas application and filing instructions (PDF)
courts.note: Use the packet for the court holding your case. If an image is missing, the records page offers an online record-request route.
